column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=This is a less detailed map showing the names of towns.
#Text=It is enlarged and more general, providing more of an overview.
#Text=There are wooded areas in the northwest with small hills, as we can see an altitude of 140 m with perhaps a small castle below.
#Text=There are urban areas and more wooded areas.
#Text=There is another wooded area in the southwest with a small stream and, in the far southwest, perhaps a dam.
#Text=Major roads are shown in orange and red, probably highways, and a railway line is shown in black with small white lines.
#Text=There is a university and, in the far northeast, a port with a cemetery, perhaps indicated by small crosses.
#Text=There is a stadium in the southwest.
